description: Track the hk tool and the hk.pkl Pkl package together. Extend this preset after mise-config so its grouping wins for hk dependencies

customManagers.description: Track the hk Pkl package pinned inside hk.pkl. The package URL carries the version twice, once in the release download path and once in the package coordinate, and both must agree or Pkl resolves a release asset that does not contain the requested package. Matching each occurrence separately means Renovate rewrites both, and repairs them if they have already drifted apart

packageRules.description: Bump the hk tool and the hk.pkl Pkl package in one PR so they stay in sync, majors included. The match is on packageName and not depName, which is what makes it work for every way the tool can be pinned. The mise manager keeps the backend prefix in depName, so aqua:jdx/hk, ubi:jdx/hk and github:jdx/hk each read as a different name, while packageName resolves to jdx/hk in all of them and in a bare hk through the mise registry. The bare hk entry stays in the list as a fallback, for the case where the registry lookup fails and packageName falls back to depName
